== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]], [[Dan Tartaglione]] (blue plaid shirt; same shirt and face as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Patrik Csapi]] (long hair and a full beard; same hair and beard as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), and [[Timo Dusel]] (short light-brown hair and a black tee with a small chest logo; same face and shirt as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026. Remaining faces unlabeled, including a yellow Gotham City Rogues tee and the man at the far end in a cap, grey tee, maroon shorts, and a sling bag (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship tournament room 1.jpg]]).


Players in front of Zu Den Vier Winden.
